speaker: Prof. Chen
text: We want to start the pilot in two weeks, but only after ethics approval is in place.
text_zh: 我们希望两周后启动 pilot，但前提是伦理审批必须先通过。

speaker: Ava
text: I will draft the study materials this week.
text_zh: 我会在本周起草实验材料。

speaker: Prof. Chen
text: I will review the materials once the draft is ready.
text_zh: 等材料初稿完成后，我会进行审核。

speaker: Jordan
text: We cannot recruit participants before the ethics board approves the protocol.
text_zh: 在伦理委员会批准方案之前，我们不能开始招募参与者。

speaker: Ava
text: Recruitment channel and participant budget are both still undecided.
text_zh: 招募渠道和参与者预算目前都还没有最终确定。
